horizon.options.server_stick.tooltip: How the stick moves on a server. Java moves only by its keys, so a server's anticheat may pull you back for the stick's own speed and angle. Analog: as you push it (servers that do not check). Free Direction: any angle at full speed, by turning the look the server sees (others see your head follow; it turns back to your view for every hit, use and block). D-pad: arrows on screen in the stick's place (a controller's stick takes the nearest of their eight directions), at full speed. A server you picked a mode for when it pulled you back keeps that one; change this while playing there to change it.
horizon.options.stick_prompt.tooltip: When a server keeps pulling you back while the stick moves you, ask how the stick should move there.
starling.stick_prompt.title: This Server Pulls You Back
starling.stick_prompt.body: Its anticheat (Grim or one like it) takes only the moves Java's keys make, and the stick's own speed and angle are not one of them. Pick how the stick moves here; Options > Controls > Controller Settings changes it any time.

horizon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
horizon.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
horizon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
horizon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.

horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, horizon-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
horizon.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Your own AI agent can play this game through horizon-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.

horizon.pages.volt_boost.tooltip: One-tap performance profiles and fine-grained optimization for terrain, entities, particles and system resources.
horizon.extras.volt_preset.tooltip: Applies a curated one-tap Volt Boost profile (OFF, Balanced, Competitive PvP, Ultra FPS, Battery Saver or Low-RAM Rescue).
horizon.extras.volt_auto_optimize.toolti: Inspects your device's CPU core count, 32/64-bit ABI and system RAM to automatically configure the optimal Volt Boost profile.
horizon.extras.volt_purge_ram.tooltip: Immediately compacts transient caches, particle buffers and unused OS heap pages to reclaim resident RAM.
horizon.extras.volt_perf_hud.tooltip: Shows a sleek crimson telemetry overlay with live FPS, 1% lows, frame pacing, active entities, chunks and resident RAM.
horizon.extras.volt_perf_hud_corner.tool: Screen corner where the live Volt Boost performance HUD docks.
horizon.extras.volt_cull_leaves.tooltip: Skips hidden interior leaf-to-leaf faces inside dense jungles and forests while keeping outer tree canopies crisp.
horizon.extras.volt_frustum_mesh.tooltip: Prioritizes chunk GPU uploads and meshing inside your camera view cone first so turning never reveals blank terrain.
horizon.extras.volt_cave_sky_cull.toolti: Skips sky dome, celestial bodies and cloud rendering passes when enclosed deep underground with zero sky light.
horizon.extras.volt_chunk_upload_cap.too: Caps chunk mesh GPU uploads per frame (Auto, 4, 8, 16 or 32) to eliminate camera-turn frame spikes on mobile GPUs.
horizon.extras.volt_fast_weather.tooltip: Reduces rain and snow column overdraw radius so heavy storms stay smooth on tile-based mobile GPUs.
horizon.extras.volt_distant_lod.tooltip: Shifts outer render-distance rings into Horizon's low-cost distant LOD band so wide horizons use a fraction of RAM and triangles.
horizon.extras.volt_entity_cap.tooltip: Renders nearest entities first and caps distant crowd rendering so mob farms and busy hubs never tank FPS.
horizon.extras.volt_item_cap.tooltip: Caps rendered ground item stacks and trims distant item drops after big explosions or farm harvests.
horizon.extras.volt_block_entity_cap.too: Occludes chests, signs, skulls, banners and shulkers behind solid walls and caps simultaneous block-entity draws.
horizon.extras.volt_cull_sign_text.toolt: Skips expensive glyph layout on signs and floating holograms beyond 16 blocks while keeping the sign model visible.
horizon.extras.volt_fast_shadows.tooltip: Limits entity contact shadows to nearby 16m targets or turns them off completely.
horizon.extras.volt_distant_mob_throttle: Simplifies distant entity feature overlays and pose work beyond 24 blocks.
horizon.extras.volt_hub_lag_shield.toolt: Automatically trims distant crowd armor stands, pets and players beyond 16m whenever more than 24 entities pack into one area.
horizon.extras.volt_particle_budget.tool: Caps active particles (16K Vanilla, 4,096, 2,048, 512 or OFF) and culls tiny distant particles.
horizon.extras.volt_chaos_shield.tooltip: Clamps TNT/crystal explosion debris, rapid Efficiency V block-break spray and crowded firework bursts.
horizon.extras.volt_anim_throttle.toolti: Steps animated lava, water, fire and portal atlas uploads at 10 Hz instead of 20 Hz to halve GPU texture-copy bandwidth.
horizon.extras.volt_glint_mode.tooltip: Simplifies enchantment glint shaders to held/nearby items only or disables glint overdraw completely.
horizon.extras.volt_auto_drs.tooltip: Dynamically adjusts 3D render scale to hold 60 or 120 FPS during heavy scenes while keeping UI and crosshair 100% native sharp.
horizon.extras.volt_dynamic_fps.tooltip: Automatically drops frame rate to 30 or 15 FPS while paused, in menus or AFK to save battery and cool down the SoC.
horizon.extras.volt_menu_bg.tooltip: Replaces multi-pass menu blur with an instant zero-GPU crimson-dark backdrop.
horizon.extras.volt_thermal_guard.toolti: Detects sustained mobile thermal frame-time spikes and smoothly steps down render scale and particle load before stutter hits.
horizon.extras.volt_reflex.tooltip: Minimizes render-ahead queue latency and paces touch camera sampling right before frame submission.
horizon.extras.volt_thread_boost.tooltip: Boosts render/audio threads onto prime big.LITTLE cores with 50us timer slack and coalesces background chunk workers.
horizon.extras.volt_prewarm.tooltip: Pre-warms gameplay caches and graphics pipelines during startup so entering a world has zero first-frame shader hitches.
horizon.extras.volt_audio_cap.tooltip: Caps simultaneous sound mixer bursts per tick so mob farms, redstone machines and TNT chains never crackle or stall.
horizon.extras.volt_memory_saver.tooltip: Aggressively shrinks transient buffers, recycles unloaded chunk capacity and returns freed pages to Android immediately.
horizon.extras.volt_keep_awake.tooltip: Keeps the mobile display awake during asset downloads, world generation and active sessions.
horizon.extras.volt_active_anim_cull.too: Skips GPU compute and mip-blending for animated block sprites that are not present in any resident chunk.
horizon.extras.volt_lookahead_stream.too: Prioritizes chunk generation, lighting and meshing ahead of your movement and camera direction.
horizon.extras.volt_fast_translucency.to: Uses distance-adaptive hysteresis when re-sorting distant translucent water and glass sections.
horizon.extras.volt_particle_frustum.too: Rejects off-screen and behind-camera particles before sprite lookup, lighting and billboard generation.
